name_reason: Name accurately reflects use and data type: it is the chapter-intro dialog blink/idle animation frame index (an index/counter), domain=chapter_intro_dialog, descriptor=anim_frame_idx. Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. No Ghidra address residue (no _54133-style suffix). Confirmed by all 4 accessing functions.
purpose: Chapter-intro dialog blink/idle animation frame index (master frame cycler, wrapped 0..3) for the between-chapter intro/save screen.
logic_summary: BSS dword, zero at program start. Re-seeded to 2 at the top of the dialog-blink wait loop (fd2_wait_input_with_chapter_dialog_blink). Incremented once every few BIOS ticks while the intro panel waits for input (both fd2_chapter_transition_menu's inner wait loop and the blink wait loop advance it), wrapping back to 0 after frame 3. Read by the renderers: fd2_render_chapter_intro_overlay uses it as portrait frame index with a 3->1 remap; fd2_render_chapter_intro_dialog_panels uses its parity (&1) to drive the subframe counter and its /2 to select sprite frames. Held in a 32-bit slot to match the dword INC/CMP/MOV accesses.
datatype: uint32 (dword); semantically a small unsigned frame index 0..3
element_semantics: Single scalar: current dialog animation frame number, cycled 0,1,2,3,0,... seeded to 2 on wait-loop entry.
notes: Memory at 0x54133 reads all-zero (BSS). 13 xrefs across 4 functions; WRITE xrefs at 0x2cdea/0x2cdf9 (transition menu advance+wrap), 0x2d8a8/0x2d92f (blink loop seed-to-2 + advance) confirm mutable -> is_const=false. src comment block (chtrans.c lines 623-635) already precise/accurate/ASCII and matches decompilation; no edit needed. Ghidra carries an accurate, consistent descriptive comment in the PRE_COMMENT field (PLATE is null); content is not contradictory/outdated/empty, so per 'consistent => do not touch plate' rule no plate change made (field-location PRE-vs-PLATE is a mechanism nuance outside this stage's content-divergence scope).
